Apex Pro Mechanical Gaming Keyboard

Engineered for competitive esports and high-throughput typing, the Apex Pro combines aircraft-grade aluminum alloy construction with hot-swappable mechanical switches. Experience zero-latency input with customizable actuation points and vibrant per-key dynamic RGB illumination.

Technical Specifications

Switch Type: Hot-swappable tactile mechanical switches rated for 100 million keystrokes.

Chassis Material: Anodized 5000-series aircraft-grade aluminum top plate for lifelong structural rigidity.

Keycaps: Premium double-shot PBT keycaps resistant to shine, wear, and fading over intense gaming sessions.

Polling Rate: Native 1000Hz polling rate delivering rapid 1ms response latency over USB.

Connectivity: Detachable gold-plated braided USB Type-C to Type-A connection cable.

Dimensions and Weight: 440mm x 135mm x 38mm; total weight 980g with rubberized non-slip feet.

Box Contents and Warranty

Package includes Apex Pro Mechanical Keyboard, keycap puller, switch removal tool, braided USB-C cable, and instruction manual. Backed by an industry-leading two-year comprehensive manufacturer warranty and 24/7 technical customer support.
